entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand and I don't want to hear any excuses. I'm sick of this.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, may I have your name and the order number?
The name is Karen Miller, order number is VF88602. And just so we're clear, I don't want a runaround. We had an emergency in the family, I was in the hospital, and I'm not playing games.

I understand you're frustrated, Ms. Miller, and I'm very sorry to hear about the emergency. I've pulled up your account. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It doesn't matter! I bought it, then my husband got a surprise deployment, and two days later I needed emergency surgery. I haven't even had time to breathe, let alone play with some gadget. I want my money back. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
That sounds incredibly stressful, and a manager won't be necessary. Let me just review the policy for you... one moment. Okay, I see here you received the item 17 days ago.
And? I told you what happened. I'm not paying for something I couldn't use because of a medical issue.

Of course. And according to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe, so I can process a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. It's... it's 90 days? I was expecting a fight.

Not at all. Your situation is completely understandable, and you're well within the return period. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending an email to the address on file with a pre-paid shipping label right now. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, it just came through. So I just print this and send the band back?

That's correct. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to the original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Wow. Uh, thank you, Diana. I appreciate you making that easy.
You're very welcome, Ms. Miller. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you soon. Have a good day.
